help: stage a manifest and its payload: the manifest copied from where the download left it; each file the manifest lists taken as fetched where the download left it beside the manifest (the archive, or what Safari unpacked it into), else fetched from its one-use export_url through the Safari session into the data-* directory sharing the manifest's star (manifest-<X>.json beside data-<X>/) - refused if that directory is staged or held

args.name: --manifest
args.help: the manifest, wherever the download left it - required: each export_url is one-use, so no default picks one

args.name: --to
args.help: stage under a directory instead of the stage (test escape hatch - a directory, never a machine name)

x: ~/Downloads (what sits beside the manifest; where Safari puts what it fetches)

osascript: drives Safari against the logged-in session - fronting claude.ai, evaluating JS in the front document (refused loudly under YOGA_NO_SEND)
fetch (in-page, session-authenticated): GETs each export_url the manifest lists that nothing beside the manifest already holds; each URL is one-use, so the fetch consumes it (refused loudly under YOGA_NO_SEND)
